examples.state: " Pass It On " is a song by The Coral , which was taken as the second single from their 2003 album , Magic and Medicine . " Pass It On " is The Coral 's highest charting single to date , reaching number five in the UK Singles Chart . " Pass It On " was not only released on CD and vinyl but also on DVD which contains 2 b - sides and a 3-minute documentary about the band . The song is similar in structure to The Beatles song " You Like Me Too Much " . It appeared in an episode of Scrubs , " My Turf War " and is featured in the theatrical trailer for Ken Loach 's film Looking for Eric .

examples.state: Oleg Ivanovich Dahl (; 25 May 1941 , Moscow – 3 March 1981 , Kiev ) was a Soviet actor . He acted in films , from classics of drama to fairy tales and adventures . His most popular works included Zhenya , Zhenechka and Katyusha ( 1967 ) , Chronicles of a Dive Bomber ( 1967 ) , An Old , Old Tale ( 1970 ) , King Lear ( 1969 ) , On Thursday and Never Again ( 1977 ) , September Vacation ( 1979 ) . Oleg Dahl played his last cinema role in Uninvited Friend by Leonid Maryagin in 1981 . He worked in Sovremennik Theatre ( 1963 - 1971 , 1973 - 1975 ) and in Malaia Bronnaia Theatre ( 1975 - 1978 ) .
